identification: Tall (about 30cm) tapered ovoid vase with mottled purple, red and blue crystalline/flambe-type glaze, red-glazed base with a faint three-line impressed mark and a number. Moorcroft not confirmed, Ruskin or another English flambe is possible.

entries.note: Ruskin (W. Howson Taylor) signed and dated crystalline vase, best offer accepted so actual price below the shown A$261.98; seller overseas, postage about A$56 extra. Ruskin, not Moorcroft.
Ruskin art pottery vase with crystalline glaze dated 1932, 8.25 inch, Buy It Now, postage about A$61 extra. Smaller than the lot, Ruskin.
Large Moorcroft flambe Clematis vase 24cm, UK seller, best offer accepted so actual price below the shown A$373.56. Patterned tube-lined flambe, not a plain mottled glaze.

viewing_check: Read the base mark under a light and photograph it: look for MOORCROFT / MADE IN / ENGLAND, a signature or initials, or RUSKIN ENGLAND with a date. Check for chips, cracks, hairlines and grinding on the foot rim, and tap it for a ring. Measure the height (about 30cm) and photograph the glaze in daylight.
searches_tried: eBay AU sold: moorcroft flambe vase (all patterned William Moorcroft pieces, A$165-$1,334, none a plain mottled monochrome); eBay AU sold: ruskin pottery flambe vase (crystalline Ruskin A$242-$1,543). Carters not tried. Unmarked-looking glaze points more to Ruskin or similar than Moorcroft, so the Moorcroft prices do not apply unless the mark confirms it.

identification: Circular pastel or watercolour portrait miniature of a young woman with dark curled hair and a drop earring, gilt slip, deep turned mahogany frame (about 10 cm image); verso has a trade label reading 'Done by H.T. Costantini' per the cloud notes
viewing_check: Read the verso label in full and photograph it, check whether it is a printed trade or framer's label or a handwritten attribution, look for a signature or inscription on the portrait itself, and look at the paper and medium (pastel is not typical of Costantini, who used ink, watercolour and gouache). Check for flaking, foxing and glass damage. Compare with the Leski 2019 'attributed to Costantini, portrait of a girl in original circular cedar frame' lot, which looks the closest type.
searches_tried: Invaluable (signed in as the user but sold prices are behind an upgrade wall, so skipped): Charles Henry Theodore Costantini keyword gave 19 artist lots. Recent ones: Lawsons 24 Nov 2024 (Woman in black; Colonial Mother and Child; Speaks pair), Lawsons 16 Jan 2025 (Mother and Child; Speaks pair), Lawsons 6 Apr and 6/17 Jul 2025 (Speaks pair relisted), Leski 28 Nov 2021 (Portrait of Frederick George Page), Leski 24 Nov 2019 (attributed, portrait of a girl, circular cedar frame, 22 cm), Colville Mar 2019. None have visible prices, so no SOLD entries recorded. The Lawsons pair being relisted four times suggests it kept passing in or failing to sell, but that is inference only, unconfirmed. Did not try eBay for this lot.
